108 complete rounds, 2025-06-23 to 2026-09-26. 23 of them from 2026-07-31 onward, when full stat capture began.

## What actually drives the score

Least-squares fit of score against each stat, over every complete round:

| Stat                 | R^2  | Strokes per unit | n   |
|----------------------|------|------------------|-----|
| Doubles or worse     | 0.78 | +2.09            | 108 |
| Greens in regulation | 0.54 | -1.66            | 106 |
| Penalties *          | 0.41 | +2.02            | 12  |
| Three-putts *        | 0.18 | +1.00            | 12  |
| Up-and-down % *      | 0.17 | -0.08            | 13  |
| Putts                | 0.06 | +0.42            | 108 |
| Fairways             | 0.01 | -0.31            | 107 |

\* Fewer than 15 rounds. Penalties, three-putts and up-and-down were only logged from 2026-07-31, so their R^2 is suggestive, not established.

**score = 80.2 + +2.09 x doubles_or_worse  (R^2=0.78, n=108)**

Doubles explain 78% of the variance in his scoring; greens in regulation explain less, and putts and fairways explain almost nothing. Each disaster hole costs about 2.1 strokes. A round with zero of them projects to 80.
